text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sparkling at all... How did I used 
to run when I was winning...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Trainie, what should I do so I 
can run like I used to...?"
choice_data_list:
Let's try to remember how you felt back at 
the very beginning.

As long as you've still got the will to 
fight, you can make a comeback!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
The beginning...? Like, when I first 
started running? Hmm, let's see... It was 
fun! Super fun!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
When I picked up speed, the wind whooshed 
around me... and after crossing the finish 
line, I could hear the cheers...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
......I get it now. I was so focused on 
winning that lately, maybe I just wasn't 
enjoying my runs.
choice_data_list:
If you've realized that much, I'm sure 
you'll be fine.

If you've realized that much, I'm sure 
you'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I won't overthink it and just run 
with all my might! Thanks, Trainy!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"The will to struggle... I have it... I 
really do!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I still have no idea what I should do, 
but... I don't want to stop.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Because... if I stop here, I'll never make 
it to Dubai in my whole life.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
—Our training can be much tougher. I don't 
care if it takes more time.
